name: Rate-responsive pacemaker
summary: Implanted pulse generator. An accelerometer raises the heart rate with body motion.

memory_electronics.note: Programmable CMOS electronics; radiation risk factors are dose, neutrons and pacing dependence.

battery_chem.note: Primary (non-rechargeable) lithium cell, sealed inside the housing.

followup.note: In-clinic programmer plus remote monitoring through a home transmitter or app.

gravity_function.note: Accelerometers respond to body motion and vibration, not to metabolic demand.

inputs.label: Pacing-dependent
inputs.help: Would the patient have no adequate heart rhythm without pacing?

name: Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD)
summary: Implanted defibrillator. Detects dangerous rhythms and delivers therapy.

memory_electronics.note: Single-event upsets were documented in ICD memory even at ground level.

battery_chem.note: Primary lithium cell and high-voltage capacitor.

followup.note: Remote alerts after therapy events are clinically important.

name: Tubed insulin pump with CGM
summary: Body-worn pump with reservoir and tubing, paired with a continuous glucose monitor.

inside_suit_on_eva.note: Insulin delivery cannot pause for a whole EVA.

p_rating_kpa.note: 700 to 1060 hPa operating. User guide: not tested above 10,150 ft (S49).

fluid_path.note: A pressure drop of about 200 mmHg caused unintended delivery of about 0.62% of cartridge volume.

battery_chem.note: AA cell or built-in Li-ion, depending on model.

followup.note: Data upload is optional; therapy runs locally.

gravity_function.note: Removing air bubbles relies on buoyancy (bubbles rise). Buoyancy scales with gravity.

life_critical.note: Life-sustaining therapy; insulin pens worked in orbit on Ax-4 as a backup route.

mitigations.R3_red: Do not wear inside the suit unless pump and battery pass flight certification. A clinician must design an alternative insulin plan for EVA days.
mitigations.R2_red: The pump cannot stay connected through this pressure drop safely. A clinician must design an alternative insulin plan for EVA days.

name: Cochlear implant with sound processor
summary: Implanted stimulator plus a behind-the-ear sound processor with microphones and battery.

location.note: Rules evaluate the external processor; the implant is hermetic and passive between stimulations.

battery_chem.note: Rechargeable Li-ion or disposable zinc-air, depending on model.

memory_electronics.note: The processor stores the patient's stimulation settings (MAP).

life_critical.note: Safety-relevant: hearing voice comms and alarms.

mitigations.R3_red: Do not wear the processor inside the helmet unless it passes flight certification. Agree an EVA communication plan that works without it.

name: Microprocessor knee (passive hydraulic)
summary: Hydraulic knee whose stance and swing resistance are set by a microprocessor from load and angle sensors.

charger_p_rating_kpa.note: Power supply unit rating (up to 3,000 m).

fluid_path.note: Sealed hydraulics, no gas path to the user.

body_mass_kg.note: Maximum body weight includes carried weight.

followup.note: Prosthetist software via Bluetooth. Calibration is required; without it, swing may start too early or too late.

gravity_function.note: Switching to swing requires rolling over the forefoot. Settings depend on body weight and calibration.

mitigations.R3_red: Do not wear the powered knee inside the suit unless it passes flight certification. Use a mechanical (non-electronic) knee for EVA.

name: Powered ankle-foot prosthesis
summary: Motorized ankle that adds push-off power at the end of each step.

runtime_h.note: Up to 8 h in normal use; about 90 min to charge.

dust_prohibited.note: IFU: no contact with sand or dust; it can get into the joint and damage the mechanics. Also avoid vibrations and strong electromagnetic fields.

gravity_function.note: Push-off is calculated in real time for every step and depends on walking speed, stride length and terrain.

mitigations.R3_red: Do not wear the powered ankle inside the suit unless it passes flight certification. Use a passive (unpowered) prosthetic foot for EVA.

name: Passive endoprosthesis (internal leg prosthesis)
summary: Internal knee replacement and femoral rod after limb-salvage surgery. No electronics.

location.note: Same type of implant Hayley Arceneaux flew with on Inspiration4.

followup.note: Imaging before and after the mission.

gravity_function.note: Bone around the implant depends on loading. Spaceflight bone loss was measured on 4 to 14.4 month Mir missions.
